answers.core: New data type constructors can't be created by an add-on; adding this feature would add very few lines of code to the engine and would make working with Transforms more convenient.
answers.workaround:
Yes. You can use one of these to achieve the same thing:
```gdscript
Transform(Basis.IDENTITY, origin)
Transform.IDENTITY.translated(origin)
```

title: Add a new Transform constructor: `Transform(origin: Vector3)`
